chapter_seo_title: Void Heaven Palace: A Lost World Beneath the Sky – RMJI Ch. 454
chapter_meta_description: Han Li steps into a pocket dimension created by ancient gods and realizes the scale of the power he is up against. Deals are struck and gazes are traded as the trial deepens.
og_title: The Void Heaven Palace Opens Into a New World
og_description: Han Li’s third trial awaits in a landscape that breaks all known rules of cultivation. The ancient cultivators were more than mere legends.
twitter_title: Step into a world made by gods
twitter_description: Chapter 454: Han Li discovers the second trial of the Void Heaven Palace is a primordial pocket dimension—a world that should not exist, but does.

lore_anchors.definition: An animate undead mist that drains life and traps souls; a central hazard of the Void Heaven Palace’s first trial.
A swarm-type undead creature that attacks by overwhelming the target’s soul with sheer numbers; considered a rare and dangerous encounter even for seasoned cultivators.
A legendary, self-aware spirit herb that can burrow through earth and stone to escape capture; prized for its immense alchemical value.
A thousand-year-old ghost who sacrificed his physical form and reincarnation for vengeance; speaks with cold arrogance and sharp calculation.
The present-day leader of Extreme Yin Island; a Core Formation demonic overlord with a predatory interest in Han Li.
A stable, self-contained realm created by an ancient cultivator, existing independently of the larger world; considered an impossible feat by modern standards.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A self-contained realm created by an ancient cultivator, capable of supporting life, spiritual energy, and its own ecosystem—considered a lost art in the modern cultivation world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t modern cultivators replicate this?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Profound Bone Saint explicitly states that the “heaven-and-earth-shattering” power of the ancient cultivators has been lost; the cause of their disappearance is a central mystery of the setting.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Nine-Turn Spirit Ginseng?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A legendary, highly intelligent spirit herb that can burrow through the earth to evade capture; it is Han Li’s primary target in this arc.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Extreme Yin Patriarch so obsessed with Han Li?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The narrative confirms Han Li himself does not fully understand it, but the tension is a slow-burn fuse that suggests a deeper, cultivation-level entanglement yet to be revealed.
